text_block_list.name: Top Road & Ayabe
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhhh!! Haaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: If I can just... hold out here...!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: From here, all at once...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, whoa, what happened? Both Narita 
Top Road and Admire Vega suddenly lost 
momentum..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the final stretch of the race, when it 
counted most, the two lacked their usual 
spark... and let victory slip away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It felt as though she sensed a powerful 
presence and was influenced by it, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... Ayabe... san...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Not being able to stretch out fully 
was partly due to my condition. But...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That's not all. I felt it too. The source 
of that immense pressure was...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh, this is as far as you go? How 
pathetic. However—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'd say it made for quite an exciting 
revue. Plus—I gained the conviction that 
we can compete on equal footing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: T.M.... Opera O-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(What incredible spirit... Even though she 
was still maiden at the start of this 
year, she's improved so quickly to make it 
all the way here...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(Just how hard has she been working? Her 
momentum today is...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I'm so sorry, it's so 
frustrating. I just couldn't make my move 
when I needed to...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Neither my strength nor my resolve were 
anywhere near enough...
choice_data_list: No, it couldn't be helped. You did great
No, it couldn't be helped. You did great.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her lackluster late charge was due to the 
track condition. That was definitely a big 
factor, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's another reason for the loss. And 
that is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, Top Road-san, Ayabe-san. That 
was quite a splendid opening act, wouldn't 
you say?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I would love for our next race to go just 
like this. A fiery waltz!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking closer, her cheeks were pale from 
exhaustion, and her body was still 
frail...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting the year with a winning streak 
before even properly preparing. And then 
pushing forward through a grueling 
schedule to enter the Satsuki Sho...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Normally, her body would never hold up. 
And yet, this sheer spirit blowing past 
all her battered exhaustion is...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What's with that look, as if you've been 
struck by a magic bullet? You simply 
hadn't realized my hidden power until now.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Haven't you forgotten? An Umamusume's 
strength is neither about speed nor her 
race record."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Neither speed nor track record? Then...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! In short, it is about 'caliber'! 
The little details are nothing more than 
jewels on a crown.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If one is a king, they will triumph in the 
end. By overpowering everything, without 
fail!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Let's meet at the Japan Derby!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ... Ayabe...-san.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I thought the Classic Triple Crown 
would be a showdown with you. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"It's not that simple. If you can't even 
manage your own physical condition..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
An unexpected rival can trip you up at any 
moment. To think that Opera O would...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer... The next Japanese Derby is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road nods. The Opera O who 
played the clown has finally cast off her 
veil.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Nippon Derby was undoubtedly shaping 
up to be a three-way battle.
